title: Shadows of the Past
content:
The last rays of the setting sun painted the sky in shades of orange and crimson.

Siddu stood silently, watching the horizon through the enormous glass windows.

Just then...

A gentle voice spoke from behind.

"How are you, Siddu?"

A faint smile appeared on his face.

"I'm fine, Shreya."

Slowly, he turned around.

Shreya walked toward him and stopped beside him.

For a few moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Five years had passed.

Yet neither of them knew how to begin a conversation that had been left unfinished for so long.

Finally, Siddu broke the silence.

"What about you?"

Shreya smiled faintly.

"Life has been... peaceful."

Another silence followed.

The cool evening breeze brushed against the glass walls of the building.

Outside, the sun slowly disappeared beyond the horizon.

The city gradually came alive with lights.

The streets below sparkled as buildings, vehicles, and street lamps illuminated the evening.

Shreya took a slow breath.

"Actually..."

"I didn't want to disturb your life."

"My manager, Varun, has worked incredibly hard to build our company."

"He wanted this partnership with your company more than anything."

"I even tried to avoid coming to France..."

"But he didn't leave me much of a choice."

Siddu smiled gently.

"Relax, Shreya."

"I'm not angry with you."

She looked at him for a moment before quietly turning her gaze back toward the city.

The silence between them no longer felt uncomfortable.

It felt peaceful.

After watching the city lights for a while, Siddu asked,

"So..."

"Tell me about yourself."

Shreya smiled.

"It's good."

"I enjoy my work."

"Even though every day feels like a routine..."

"I like staying busy."

"I spend time with my parents whenever I can."

"And helping them makes me happy."

Siddu nodded with a smile.

"I'm glad."

After a brief pause, he hesitated before asking,

"Are you... seeing someone?"

Shreya's smile slowly disappeared.

She lowered her eyes.

"No."

"Ever since Karthik..."

"I've never been able to love anyone else."

Siddu frowned.

"What do you mean?"

"I thought you both were living happily together."

Shreya remained silent.

Something about her expression immediately made Siddu uneasy.

"Shreya...?"

She didn't answer.

He called her name once again, this time a little louder.

"Shreya."

She slowly looked up.

There was sadness in her eyes.

"You... don't know?"

Siddu frowned.

"Know what?"

A tear quietly escaped her eye.

"Karthik..."

"He's dead."

Siddu's eyes widened.

"What...?"

"He died?"

Shreya slowly nodded.

"He was murdered."

The words hit Siddu like lightning.

"Murdered?"

"By whom?"

She took a deep breath before answering.

"A man named Anish."

Siddu stood frozen.

"Why...?"

Shreya looked toward the dark sky.

"Karthik betrayed him."

"He fell in love with Anish's girlfriend."

"When Anish found out..."

"He and a few of his friends killed Karthik."

Siddu couldn't believe what he had just heard.

The Karthik he had once known had met such a tragic end.

For a few moments, he stood there in complete silence, unable to find the right words.

Silence filled the air once again.

The lights of France continued to shine brightly...

But for both of them...

The evening had suddenly become much darker.
